title: King Hussein Bin Talal Senior Lecturer in Public Leadership
affiliation: King Hussein Bin Talal Senior Lecturer in Public Leadership
bio: Ronald Heifetz is among the world’s foremost authorities on the practice and teaching of leadership. He advises governments, businesses, and nonprofit organizations across the globe. In 2016, President Juan Manuel Santos of Colombia highlighted Heifetz’s advice in his Nobel Peace Prize Lecture.
research_interests: Politics Business & Regulation Democracy & Governance Gender
